resolved.title: finally 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]finally[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

After a [b]try/except[/b] statement, a [b]finally[/b] block can follow. It will execute after the [b]try/except [/b]block, no matter if an exception occurred or not.[code format="py" codeId="347"]try:
   print("Hello")
   print(1 / 0)
except ZeroDivisionError:
   print("Divided by zero")
[b]finally:[/b]
   print("This code will run no matter what")[/code]
[note]The [b]finally[/b] block is useful, for example,  when working with files and resources: it can be used to make sure files or resources are closed or released regardless of whether an exception occurs.[/note]

content.text: 在一个**try/except**语句之后，可以有一个**finally**语句块。它将在**try/except**块之后执行，无论是否发生异常。
content.text_html:
After a try/except statement, a finally block can follow. It will execute after the **try/except **block, no matter if an exception occurred or not.

在一个try/except语句之后，可以有一个finally块。它将在**try/except **块之后执行，无论是否发生异常。

content.content:
try:
    print("Hello")
    print(1 / 0)
except ZeroDivisionError:
    print("Divided by zero")
finally:
    print("This code will run no matter what")

content.text: 例如，在处理文件和资源时，**finally**块很有用：它可以用来确保文件或资源被关闭或释放，无论是否发生异常。
content.text_html:
The finally block is useful, for example, when working with files and resources: it can be used to make sure files or resources are closed or released regardless of whether an exception occurs.

例如，在处理文件和资源时，finally块很有用：它可以用来确保文件或资源被关闭或释放，无论是否发生异常。

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]else[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The [b]else[/b] statement can also be used with [b]try/except[/b] statements. 
In this case, the code within it is only executed if no error occurs in the [b]try [/b]statement.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="451"][b]try:[/b]
   print(1)
[b]except [/b]ZeroDivisionError:
   print(2)
[b]else:[/b]
   print(3)

[b]try:[/b]
   print(1/0)
[b]except [/b]ZeroDivisionError:
   print(4)
[b]else:[/b]
   print(5)[/code]

resolved.title: 菜单选择助手
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个数字菜单来订购食材。

该菜单存储在列表`menu`中。
现在输入某个菜单对应的编号(数字，即索引)，并输出菜单中对应的食材名。

如果索引无效，则输出 "**Item not found**"。
如果索引是有效的，则输出食材名，并再换行输出"**Thanks for your order**"。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]else[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a digital menu to order food.
The menu is stored as a list of items.
Your program needs to take the index of the item as input and output the item name.
In case the index is not valid, you should output "[b]Item not found[/b]".
In case the index is valid and the item name is output successfully, you should output "[b]Thanks for your order[/b]".

[b]Sample Input[/b]
2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Cheeseburger
Thanks for your order

[note]Handle the cases when the input is out of range, as well as when it is not a number.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 考虑输入超出范围的情况，以及不是数字的情况。

code_templates.template:
# 菜单
menu = ['Fries', 'Sandwich', 'Cheeseburger', 'Coffee', 'Soda']
#此处编写代码
code_templates.solution_code:
menu = ['Fries', 'Sandwich', 'Cheeseburger', 'Coffee', 'Soda'] 
 
try:
    n=int(input())
    print(menu[n])
    print("Thanks for your order")
except:
    print("Item not found")
